race.comment: UTAH (8) resumed for a new stable, and after moving up like the winner on the turn, he fought bravely to finish second by a head. His only win has been second up, and he is nicely poised to go one better here. OR AM I (10) has not been too bad in a couple of runs since leaving maidens in style at Murray Bridge 3 starts ago. She has been a late scratching since her last run nearly 3 weeks ago, and as long as she has not missed any vital work, she can have a say in the finish here. Each way value. SEA ROADS (4) is fresh up, and he usually takes a run, but this field is very even, so keep him safe. NOYERS (3) needed the run fresh up, and he will improve with racing. He is a lightly tried 8YO gelding with top 4 claims, especially if there is any market confidence.
